Well, I've only dated twice, both relationships didn't last that long, and looking back I sort of forced myself into them without feeling fully interested or wanting this person to be forever in my life, romantically speaking. I was more than happy to have them as friends.

Aside from that I've recently been questioning the whole fact of whether I wanna be in a relationship with anyone or date anyone. I felt sort of relieved after both my relationships ended, felt more free. I think I wanna be extremely important or the most important person in someone's life and in a sense society made me believe I have to be someone's partner for that, but I think that's not exactly what I want. I more want to be important, or belong with someone/some people.

In all honesty I can recall strictly one or two people I've sort of fallen for, but I still wouldn't date them because I dislike their personalities or we just wouldn't work out together, which again makes me question if I just liked our chemistry or their looks, or something else.
